description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryService class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. The class provides methods for managing job categories, including listing, retrieving by ID, saving, deleting, and normalizing job category data. It acts as a service layer that interacts with the JobCategoryDao data access object and utilizes traits for normalization.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: Service class for managing job categories, providing functionalities like listing, retrieval, saving, deletion, and normalization of job category data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with a new JobCategoryDao instance.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories with optional sorting, limiting, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Retrieves a job category by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Saves a JobCategory object to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes job categories based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job category data.
